title: A Midsummer Night's Dream

vibeProfile.oneLine: Lovers, fairies and a love potion tangle on a magical midsummer night.

summary: On a magical midsummer night, four young lovers, a troupe of bumbling amateur actors, and a court of quarrelling fairies collide in an enchanted wood, where a mischievous sprite's love potion turns everything joyfully upside down. Shakespeare's most beloved comedy is a shimmering dream of desire, confusion and reconciliation, ending in laughter and blessing. Light, funny and endlessly charming, it is the most purely delightful thing he wrote and a perfect first Shakespeare for anyone.
whyReadIt: Shakespeare's most delightful comedy, all fairies, lovers and mischief in an enchanted wood. Pure joy.

funFacts.text: The mischievous fairy Puck's closing speech is among the most quoted in all of Shakespeare.
